completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the National Parks Board (Certification Marks) Notification 2019 and comes into operation on 1 April 2019.

2. The International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) Mark (defined under the International Standards on Phytosanitary Measures (ISPM 15)) set out in the Schedule is a certification mark of the Board for the export of wood packaging materials.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Certification mark for the export of
wood packaging materials
*SG-000 is a unique number assigned by the Board to the authorised agency that performs treatment standards defined under ISPM 15.
